summary: A17 built a four-page Snapshot DSL handbook (1200x1600 each) plus four standalone 400x240 examples. Eight real document fetches (511,484 B, all 200) supplied every claim, and the sources.md file connects each conclusion back to a retained file and line number. Thirteen probes measured line boxes, monospace advance and whitespace semantics, and settled two claims empirically (Raw outside Text and Expanded in the wrong place both return 400). Four BackdropFilter probes isolated a real finding the docs do not contain: an ImageFiltered subtree inside the same Stack disables the backdrop blur, which was fixed by moving it out. The printed code is the example's own text, emitted verbatim through Raw+CDATA with the ]]> terminator split across two CDATA sections, and all four rebuilt 17-line snippets were submitted and accepted. Each page embeds its example's DSL subtree rather than an Image, and after wrapping it in ClipRect all four illustrations compare at 0 differing pixels against their standalone example across the full 400x240 window. 50 requests (42 render, 8 document; 45x200, 5x400 with all bodies retained), 123.3 s of request time, 42 iteration rows with 10 complete visual iterations, 5 defects found by actually opening the images, 1 found only by pixel comparison and 3 caught in a document accuracy review before delivery, 22 successful image views covering all 8 delivered images, and a final audit reporting problems = 0.
